changelog.summary: 0.8.0-beta.2 publishes Generic CMS 0.8.0-beta.2 with the approved BUG-01 to BUG-04 fixes and removes the unused Adoption interface. Desktop and Publisher remain 0.8.0-beta.1.

desktop.changelog: Unchanged from the approved beta.1 desktop package.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged from the approved beta.1 Publisher Q-App.

cms.changelog: Generic CMS beta.2: Android featured-image publication, native catalog loading, public navigation during catalog errors, warning-banner cleanup and removal of the unused Adoption interface.
